item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 17:51): Microsoft outage: Millions affected in over 70 countries
item.description:
Originally published Fri 13 Nov 2026 17:51 IST.

A global Microsoft outage hits schools, doctors and businesses. The tech giant is scrambling the fix the issue - but with so many of us relying on its products such as Outlook and Teams, it has prompted a conversation about how reliant we are on its services. Microsoft says it's not found any evidence that malicious activity caused the problems, and in its latest update it reported that "broader improvements" were being observed in North America and Europe.

Also: El Salvador soldiers use combat robot dogs equipped with assault rifles to re-take the national football stadium from gangs in Haiti. The FBI says North Korean hackers used fake video calls in a 400-million dollar crypto hack. Mauricio Pochettino is finally confirmed as Manchester United's new manager. We go inside a secret wartime bunker rediscovered beneath cliffs on the south coast England.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
